title: Passive trees
kicker: Power and builds · level up and power
hook: **Vision:** spend souls into trees for identity and risk — many trees can be equal in expected value; concentrating buys reward and risk.

blindSpots.meaning: Not in the current loop. You cannot open finished trees as a live system yet.
A learnable passive catalog you spend into — a face for the build, not a class pick.
Stacking one tree harder for bigger reward and bigger risk.
Trees are meant to be learnable and shared — not locked behind a secret wiki.

alsoTrue: Respec costs souls in the design.
Live power today is aptitudes and Dave — see [aptitudes](aptitudes).

sections.title: Not in the current loop
paras: Treat this as future identity on the power spine.
Do not wait on trees to play lawn and roster loops.

sections.title: Design intent
paras: Trees give a build a face.
Equal EV across many trees keeps choice honest; concentration is the risk knob.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Read it as Vision, not a missing button bug.
Spend souls on altar and pacts today.
Use aptitudes for live free-build power.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as aptitudes?
mixUps.a: No. Aptitudes are the twelve free-build stats live now.
Design says catalogs are learnable and shared — no secret wiki lock.
Trees would spend souls; souls already have altar and tribute sinks.
